task_definition.task_name: First Motion Polarity Classification using DiTingMotion on Diting

task_description.overview: Automatically classify P-wave first-motion polarity (up or down) from seismic waveform data using a pretrained deep learning model (DiTingMotion).
steps: Load the pretrained DiTingMotion model and set it to evaluation mode.
Load seismic waveform data from a .npz file, extract the vertical component (Z) and compute its difference (dZ).
Stack Z and dZ into a two-channel input array and normalize each trace (mean subtraction and max amplitude scaling).
Convert the normalized data to a torch tensor and run inference through the model to obtain polarity probabilities.
Determine the predicted polarity class (0 for up, 1 for down) and probability for each trace.
Load the ground truth polarity labels from a CSV file, map them to numeric values, and compare against predictions.
Compute classification accuracy (excluding invalid labels) and generate a scatter plot comparing true vs. predicted polarities.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Perform first motion polarity classification on the 3-component seismic dataset (Diting) using `ditingmotion` deep learning model. Load and normalize the seismic data from {data_path} with the specific {normalize_mode} mode, then use the z-component and its difference (dz) as the model input. The pretrained ditingmotion model is located at {pretrained_model_path}, and its related parameters are {model_params}. 
 (1) Run inference and save the first motion polarity classification results into a csv file. 
 (2) Load the target first motion polarity from {target_path} by reading the columns `p_motion`, note the mapping of the polarity is {polarity_mapping}
 (3) Plot one figure showing the first motion polarity classification results and the target first motion polarity. The result data should be saved to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}, and the result figure should be saved to {result_figure}.
